text: The Nominating Panel – Administrative Penalty Tribunal will conduct interviews and recommend thirteen (13) candidates to City Council for appointment to the Administrative Penalty Tribunal.

The Nominating Panel - Administrative Penalty Tribunal recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Administrative Penalty Tribunal, for a term of office ending on December 15, 2027, and until successors are appointed: Ashifa Alibhai Jennifer Ansell Daniel Boyer Natasha Bronfman Emily Cole Joanne Foot Suzanne Graves Jenny Gumbs Mumtaz Jiwan Norine Nathanson Jeffrey Shapiro Harold Tan Helen Walsh
